recalls.subject: Avride Inc. (Avride) is recalling certain Automated Driving Systems (ADS) equipped with software versions prior to RC-01-05. The ADS softwar
recalls.summary: Avride Inc. (Avride) is recalling certain Automated Driving Systems (automated driving system) equipped with software versions prior to RC-01-05.
recalls.source_detail: Avride Inc. (Avride) is recalling certain Automated Driving Systems (ADS) equipped with software versions prior to RC-01-05. The ADS software may direct the vehicle to change lanes, merge, or veer left or right without yielding or maintaining a safe distance from other vehicles.
recalls.consequence: Unexpected vehicle movement may increase the risk of a crash.
recalls.remedy: Avride will update the ADS software, free of charge. All affected ADS-equipped fleet vehicles will be updated by August 31, 2026.
recalls.status: Recall announced; remedy information in official record

recalls.subject: ADS may not detect heavy smoke in roadway
recalls.summary: Zoox recalled automated driving software on 105 vehicles because it could fail to detect heavy smoke and drive into low-visibility areas, particularly active emergency scenes, raising crash risk and potentially impeding first responders. Zoox has updated the software free of charge (Zoox recall 26-01).
recalls.source_detail: Zoox, Inc. (Zoox) is recalling certain Automated Driving Systems (ADS). The ADS software may fail to detect heavy smoke, allowing the vehicle to enter an area of low visibility, particularly active emergency scenes.
recalls.consequence: Failing to respond to low visibility conditions can increase the risk of a crash or impede first responders.
recalls.remedy: Zoox has updated the ADS software, free of charge. Zoox's number for this recall is 26-01.
recalls.status: Recall announced; remedy information in official record

recalls.subject: Waymo LLC (Waymo) is recalling certain 5th Generation Automated Driving Systems (ADS). The software may allow the vehicle to enter a closed
recalls.summary: The software may allow the vehicle to enter a closed freeway construction zone and continue driving at speed.
recalls.source_detail: Waymo LLC (Waymo) is recalling certain 5th Generation Automated Driving Systems (ADS). The software may allow the vehicle to enter a closed freeway construction zone and continue driving at speed.
recalls.consequence: Driving through a closed construction zone increases the risk of a crash.
recalls.remedy: Beginning June 16, 2026 Waymo updated the ADS software to detect when the vehicle is in and to avoid entering construction zones, free of charge. Waymo resumed vehicle operations on freeway June 25, 2026.
recalls.status: Recall announced; remedy information in official record

recalls.subject: Waymo LLC (Waymo) is recalling certain 5th and 6th Generation Automated Driving Systems (ADS). The software may allow the vehicle to slow an
recalls.summary: The software may allow the vehicle to slow and then drive into standing water on higher speed roadways.
recalls.source_detail: Waymo LLC (Waymo) is recalling certain 5th and 6th Generation Automated Driving Systems (ADS). The software may allow the vehicle to slow and then drive into standing water on higher speed roadways.
recalls.consequence: Entering a flooded roadway can cause a loss of vehicle control, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.
recalls.remedy: The remedy is currently under development. As an interim remedy, Waymo modified the scope of vehicle operations to increase weather-related constraints and updated the vehicle maps. All affected vehicles received the interim update by April 20, 2026.
recalls.status: Recall announced; remedy information in official record

recalls.summary: The Image Processing Module A (IPMA) may experience multiple unexpected resets, resulting in loss of the rearview camera image and advanced driver assistance (driver-assistance system) features, including pre-collision assist, lane-keeping assist, and blind-spot monitoring.
recalls.source_detail: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2022-2025 Lincoln Navigator, 2024-2025 Lincoln Nautilus, 2025 Lincoln Aviator and Explorer vehicles. The Image Processing Module A (IPMA) may experience multiple unexpected resets, resulting in loss of the rearview camera image and advanced driver assistance (ADAS) features, including pre-collision assist, lane-keeping assist, and blind-spot monitoring.
recalls.consequence: Loss of the rearview camera image and certain driver assistance features, can reduce the driverâs ability to detect hazards, increasing the risk of a crash.
recalls.remedy: The Image Processing Module A software will be updated by a dealer, or through an over-the-air (OTA) update, free of charge. This is a Phased campaign. Phase 1 will include 2025 Aviator, 2025 Explorer, 2025 Nautilus notified owners on 4/13/2026. Phase 2 will include 2025 Navigator will notify owners on or about 4/20/2026. Phase 3 will include 2022-2024 Navigator will notify owners on or about 6/8/2026. Phase 4 will include 2024 Nautilus will notify owners on or about 6/22/2026. Owner notification letters were mailed April 13, 2026. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 26S21. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning March 25, 2026.
recalls.status: Recall announced; remedy information in official record

recalls.subject: ADS software may cause lane-line crossings near intersections
recalls.summary: Zoox recalled software on 332 vehicles that unnecessarily crossed lane lines at or near intersections; in some cases the vehicle stopped in front of oncoming traffic, which could raise crash risk, though no collisions occurred. Zoox found 62 instances after an August 26, 2025 wide-turn incident and updated all vehicles by December 19, 2025.
recalls.source_detail: Zoox, Inc. (Zoox) is recalling certain Automated Driving Systems (ADS) equipped with software versions released prior to December 29, 2025. At or near intersections, Zoox vehicles may cross the yellow center line and drive into or stop in front of oncoming traffic.
recalls.consequence: Crossing or stopping in front of oncoming traffic can increase the risk of a crash.
recalls.remedy: Zoox has updated the ADS software, free of charge. All affected driverless fleet vehicles were repaired by December 29, 2025. Zoox's number for this recall is 25-04.
recalls.status: Recall announced; remedy information in official record

recalls.subject: Waymo LLC (Waymo) is recalling certain 5th Generation Automated Driving Systems (ADS) operating a software version prior to the November 5,
recalls.summary: Waymo LLC (Waymo) is recalling certain 5th Generation Automated Driving Systems (automated driving system) operating a software version prior to the November 5, 2025 release.
recalls.source_detail: Waymo LLC (Waymo) is recalling certain 5th Generation Automated Driving Systems (ADS) operating a software version prior to the November 5, 2025 release. The software may cause the vehicle to pass a stopped school bus even when the red lights are flashing and/or stop arm is extended.
recalls.consequence: Passing a stopped school bus increases risk of crash with a pedestrian.
recalls.remedy: Waymo has updated the ADS software, free of charge. All affected vehicles were repaired by November 17, 2025.
recalls.status: Recall announced; remedy information in official record

recalls.subject: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025 Lincoln Navigator, F-150, Expedition, Bronco, and Ranger vehicles. The Electronic Brake
recalls.summary: The Electronic Brake Booster (EBB) module may malfunction while driving or when the driver is utilizing an Advanced Driver Assistance System (driver-assistance system) feature, resulting in a loss of power brake assist.
recalls.source_detail: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025 Lincoln Navigator, F-150, Expedition, Bronco, and Ranger vehicles. The Electronic Brake Booster (EBB) module may malfunction while driving or when the driver is utilizing an Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) feature, resulting in a loss of power brake assist.
recalls.consequence: An unexpected loss of power brake assist while driving can extend stopping distance and increase the risk of a crash. Additionally, a loss of power brake assist while ADAS features are engaged can result in the vehicle not braking as expected, increasing the risk of a crash.
recalls.remedy: Dealers will replace the electronic brake booster, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed February 26, 2026. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 25SD4. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on December 3, 2025.
recalls.status: Recall announced; remedy information in official record

recalls.subject: ADS may not detect people immediately next to the vehicle
recalls.summary: Zoox recalled software on 270 vehicles that, at speeds under 0.5 m/s, might not detect a prone vulnerable road user immediately beside the vehicle and resume moving, risking injury. It followed a May 8, 2025 San Francisco incident with a fallen e-scooter rider; updated software reached all vehicles by May 21, 2025.
recalls.source_detail: Zoox, Inc. (Zoox) is recalling certain Automated Driving Systems (ADS) equipped with software versions released prior to May 21, 2025. The ADS may allow the vehicle to move after failing to detect a person right next to the vehicle.
recalls.consequence: A vehicle that moves when a person is right next to the vehicle increases the risk of injury or crash.
recalls.remedy: Zoox has updated the ADS software, free of charge. All affected driverless fleet vehicles were repaired by May 21, 2025. Zoox's number for this recall is 25-03.
recalls.status: Recall announced; remedy information in official record

recalls.subject: Waymo LLC (Waymo) is recalling certain 5th Generation Automated Driving Systems (ADS) with software versions released prior to the November
recalls.summary: Waymo LLC (Waymo) is recalling certain 5th Generation Automated Driving Systems (automated driving system) with software versions released prior to the November 7, 2024 software release.
recalls.source_detail: Waymo LLC (Waymo) is recalling certain 5th Generation Automated Driving Systems (ADS) with software versions released prior to the November 7, 2024 software release.  The software may cause the vehicles to collide with certain roadway barriers, such as chains and gates.
recalls.consequence: A vehicle that crashes into chains, gates, or other gate-like roadway barriers increases the risk of injury.
recalls.remedy: Waymo has updated the ADS software, free of charge.  All affected vehicles were repaired by December 26, 2024.
recalls.status: Recall announced; remedy information in official record

recalls.subject: ADS prediction error may prevent avoiding a collision
recalls.summary: Zoox recalled software on 270 vehicles that, above 40 mph, could wrongly predict that a car creeping out of a perpendicular driveway would enter its lane, delaying evasive action and raising collision risk. It followed an April 8, 2025 Las Vegas collision with no injuries; updated software reached all vehicles by April 17, 2025.
recalls.source_detail: Zoox, Inc. (Zoox) is recalling certain Automated Driving Systems (ADS) equipped with software versions released prior to April 17, 2025.  In certain driving scenarios, the Zoox vehicle may make an inaccurate prediction when another vehicle slowly approaches perpendicularly and stops.  In these scenarios, the Zoox vehicle may not be able to avoid a crash.
recalls.consequence: Inaccurately predicting the movement of another vehicle increases the risk of a crash.
recalls.remedy: Zoox has updated the ADS software, free of charge.  All affected driverless fleet vehicles operating on public roads were repaired by April 17, 2025.  Zoox's number for this recall is 25-02.
recalls.status: Recall announced; remedy information in official record

recalls.subject: Unexpected hard braking
recalls.summary: Zoox recalled software on 258 vehicles covering two issues: braking unnecessarily hard for a bicyclist near a crosswalk after a light turned green, and for a vulnerable road user rapidly approaching from behind. The hard braking risked rear-end collisions; updated software (version 24.32) reached all vehicles by November 7, 2024.
recalls.source_detail: Zoox, Inc. (Zoox) is recalling certain Automated Driving Systems (ADS) equipped with software versions released prior to November 5, 2024.  In certain driving scenarios, such as when a motorcyclist rapidly approaches the rear of the vehicle or a cyclist enters a nearby crosswalk, the vehicle may brake hard unexpectedly.
recalls.consequence: Unexpected hard braking can increase the risk of a crash.
recalls.remedy: Zoox has updated the ADS software, free of charge.  All affected driverless fleet vehicles were repaired by November 7, 2024.  Zoox's number for this recall is 25-01.
recalls.status: Recall announced; remedy information in official record

recalls.remedy: Dealers install an anti-siphon vent, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 5, 2024.  Owners may contact Forest River Customer Service at (574) 825-4995.  Forest River's number for this recall is 103-1854.
recalls.status: Recall announced; remedy information in official record

recalls.summary: The recall concerns cruiser rv is recalling certain 2024-2025 stryker travel trailers, equipped with optional onan 5.5 generators. these generators may not be proper.
recalls.source_detail: Cruiser RV is recalling certain 2024-2025 Stryker travel trailers, equipped with optional Onan 5.5 generators.  These generators may not be properly vented and allow the generator to overheat or prevent exhaust gas from escaping properly.

recalls.summary: Cruise LLC (Cruise) is recalling certain Automated Driving Systems (automated driving system) units equipped with software versions released prior to May 14, 2024.

recalls.summary: As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 120, "Wheels and Rims-Other Than Passenger Cars.".
recalls.source_detail: Cruiser RV (Cruiser) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Avenir trailers.  The Federal Certification labels are missing the tire size and correct PSI.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 120, "Wheels and Rims-Other Than Passenger Cars."

recalls.remedy: Cruiser will mail new certification labels, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 2, 2024.  Owners may contact Cruiser customer service at 1-574-562-3500.

recalls.source_detail: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2016-2023 Model S, Model X, 2017-2023 Model 3, and 2020-2023 Model Y vehicles equipped with Full Self-Driving Beta (FSD Beta) software or pending installation.Â  The FSD Beta system may allow the vehicle to act unsafe around intersections, such as traveling straight through an intersection while in a turn-only lane, entering a stop sign-controlled intersection without coming to a complete stop, or proceeding into an intersection during a steady yellow traffic signal without due caution. recalls.source_detail: Cruiser RV (Cruiser) is recalling certain model year 2017 Shadow Cruiser, Fun Finder, MPG, Radiance, South Fork, and Stryker recreational trailers.  The affected vehicles have an LED light on the front cap of the camper that may short circuit and overheat.
recalls.consequence: If the light overheats there would be an increased risk of a fire.
recalls.remedy: Cruiser will notify owners, and dealers will replace the light with one that has built-in voltage protection.  The recall began on September 1, 2016.  Owners may contact Cruiser customer service at 1-260-562-3500.
recalls.status: Recall announced; remedy information in official record

recalls.subject: Cruiser RV (Cruiser) is recalling certain model year 2016-2017 Stryker travel trailers, models ST3316, STG3112 and STG3212, manufactured Dec
recalls.summary: The affected vehicles are equipped with safety chains on the A-frame that are rated for 11,700 lbs instead of being rated equal to, or greater than, the gross vehicle weight rating (GVWR) of the travel trailer.
recalls.source_detail: Cruiser RV (Cruiser) is recalling certain model year 2016-2017 Stryker travel trailers, models ST3316, STG3112 and STG3212, manufactured December 11, 2015, to March 10, 2016.  The affected vehicles are equipped with safety chains on the A-frame that are rated for 11,700 lbs instead of being rated equal to, or greater than, the gross vehicle weight rating (GVWR) of the travel trailer.
recalls.consequence: In the event the main trailer connection fails, the weight of the trailer can break the safety chains if the chains are not strong enough, allowing the trailer to separate from the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
recalls.remedy: Cruiser will notify owners, and dealers will replace the existing safety chains with chains that have a 16,200lb rating, free of charge.  The recall began on April 21, 2016.  Owners may contact Cruiser customer service at 1-260-562-3500.
recalls.status: Recall announced; remedy information in official record

recalls.source_detail: Cruiser RV (Cruiser) is recalling certain model year 2016 Stryker travel trailers manufactured March 23, 2015, to April 20, 2015.  In the affected trailers, the studs that are used to attach the wheels to the axle hubs may break.
recalls.consequence: If the wheel studs break, the wheel could detach from the vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
recalls.remedy: Cruiser will notify owners, and dealers will replace any affected wheel hub, free of charge. The recall began on July 14, 2015.  Owners may contact Cruiser customer service at 1-866-277-5630.  Cruiser's number for this recall is 11043R & 11044R.
recalls.status: Recall announced; remedy information in official record

recalls.subject: Cruiser RV (Cruiser) is recalling certain model year 2015 Viewfinder recreational trailers manufactured September 4, 2014, to March 30, 2015
recalls.summary: The recall concerns cruiser rv (cruiser) is recalling certain model year 2015 viewfinder recreational trailers manufactured september 4, 2014, to march 30, 2015. in .
recalls.source_detail: Cruiser RV (Cruiser) is recalling certain model year 2015 Viewfinder recreational trailers manufactured September 4, 2014, to March 30, 2015.  In the affected vehicles, the liquid propane (LP) compartment in the slide room is not properly sealed to the interior of the trailer.  If a leak occurs in the LP compartment, propane gas could dissipate into the interior of the trailer.
recalls.consequence: A propane gas leak into the interior of the trailer increases the risk of a fire in the presence of an ignition source.
recalls.remedy: Cruiser will notify owners, and dealers will modify the recreational trailer so that the LP compartment is sealed from the passenger area, free of charge.  The recall began on May 14, 2015.  Owners may contact Cruiser customer service at 1-866-277-5630.  Cruiser's number for this recall is 11041R.
recalls.status: Recall announced; remedy information in official record

recalls.subject: Cruiser RV (Cruiser) is recalling certain model year 2016 Stryker Toy and Stryker Toy Hauler trailers manufactured July 21, 2014, to January
recalls.summary: The recall concerns cruiser rv (cruiser) is recalling certain model year 2016 stryker toy and stryker toy hauler trailers manufactured july 21, 2014, to january 9, 2.
recalls.source_detail: Cruiser RV (Cruiser) is recalling certain model year 2016 Stryker Toy and Stryker Toy Hauler trailers manufactured July 21, 2014, to January 9, 2015, and equipped with an optional slide floor.  In the affected trailers, the slide floor can be flipped up to access the storage space underneath.  If the floor is flipped up while the trailer is stationary, the trailer occupants may be exposed to exhaust fumes from the generator or fumes from the exterior fueling station.
recalls.consequence: If the optional slide floor is opened and the occupants are exposed to fumes, there is an increased risk of injury.
recalls.remedy: Cruiser will notify owners, and dealers will secure the slide floor so that it cannot be opened, completely sealing it from the occupant space, free of charge. The recall began April 14, 2015. Owners may contact Cruiser customer service at 1-866-277-5630.
recalls.status: Recall announced; remedy information in official record

recalls.subject: General Motors LLC (GM) is recalling certain model year 2013-2015 Cadillac XTS vehicles manufactured February 14, 2012, to August 22, 2014,
recalls.summary: The recall concerns general motors llc (gm) is recalling certain model year 2013-2015 cadillac xts vehicles manufactured february 14, 2012, to august 22, 2014, and 2.
recalls.source_detail: General Motors LLC (GM) is recalling certain model year 2013-2015 Cadillac XTS vehicles manufactured February 14, 2012, to August 22, 2014, and 2014-2015 Chevrolet Impala vehicles manufactured November 5, 2012, to September 2, 2014.  In the affected vehicles, the electronic parking brake piston actuation arm may not fully retract causing the brake pads to stay partially engaged.
recalls.consequence: Brake pads that remain partially engaged with the rotors may cause excessive brake heat that may result in a fire.
recalls.remedy: GM will notify owners, and dealers will update the electronic parking brake software, free of charge.  The recall began on October 28, 2014.  Owners may contact Chevrolet customer service at 1-800-222-1020, or Cadillac customer service at 1-800-458-8006.  GM's number for this recall is 14471.
recalls.status: Recall announced; remedy information in official record

recalls.subject: Cruiser RV is recalling certain model year 2006-2013 Fun Finder, Shadow Cruiser, Fun Finder Xtra, Viewfinder, Signature, Radiance, Enterra r
recalls.summary: The recall concerns cruiser rv is recalling certain model year 2006-2013 fun finder, shadow cruiser, fun finder xtra, viewfinder, signature, radiance, enterra recrea.
recalls.source_detail: Cruiser RV is recalling certain model year 2006-2013 Fun Finder, Shadow Cruiser, Fun Finder Xtra, Viewfinder, Signature, Radiance, Enterra recreational trailers manufactured January 1, 2006, through April 25, 2013 and equipped with Fastec-brand door locks.  It may be possible to remove the key from the lock in a way that potentially jams the deadbolt.
recalls.consequence: If the deadbolt jams, the interior side of the door lock may also jam.  A person inside the travel trailer at the time will then be locked in and be unable to exit the vehicle without using the emergency exit, increasing the risk of injury.
recalls.remedy: Cruiser RV will notify owners, and Fastec will coordinate the inspection and replacement of the cylinders, as needed, free of charge.  The recall began January 20, 2014.  Owners may contact Cruiser RV at 1-260-562-3500 or Fastec at 1-800-837-2505.
recalls.status: Recall announced; remedy information in official record

recalls.subject: American Honda Motor Company (Honda) is recalling certain model year 2007-2008 Honda Odyssey vehicles manufactured August 8, 2006, through S
recalls.summary: Due to a combination of system components and software, the Vehicle Safety Assist System (VSA) may apply the brakes unexpectedly.
recalls.source_detail: American Honda Motor Company (Honda) is recalling certain model year 2007-2008 Honda Odyssey vehicles manufactured August 8, 2006, through September 8, 2008.  Due to a combination of system components and software, the Vehicle Safety Assist System (VSA) may apply the brakes unexpectedly.
recalls.consequence: The vehicle may suddenly and unexpectedly brake hard, and without illuminating the brake lights, increasing the risk of a crash from behind.
recalls.remedy: Parts to remedy these vehicles will not be available until the spring of 2014.  Honda will send owners an interim letter notifying them of the issue and instruct them how to prevent unintended braking.  A second notification will be sent when the parts become available.  Interim notification was mailed in December 2013.  The recall began on April 29, 2014.   Owners may contact Honda at 1-800-999-1009 or visit their website at www.recalls.honda.com.  Honda's recall number is JC5.
recalls.status: Recall announced; remedy information in official record
